messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained throughput degradation and rising tail latency observed for dedicated pools in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. p95 for embeddings up ~3x, overall throughput down ~40% for high-batch jobs. Error rate unchanged. Paging oncall.

marisol (oncall): ack. taking lead. looking at pool metrics and recent infra/runtime changes. paging runtime + platform. @evan @tara please stand by.

evan (sre): seeing long head-of-line queuing on dedicated-batch-pool-1 and -2. Batch workers show long tokenization hold times (tokenizer lock contended). CPU for workers high during tokenization phase, GPUs idle between bursts -> inefficient pipeline.

tara (eng-runtime): we rolled tokenizer-cache refactor ~22m ago to dedupe tokenizer instances and add a shared cache to reduce memory. smells like a regressing global lock. pulling logs and flamegraphs.

ops-bot: @tara requested: /tools/collect-flame --nodes dedicated-batch-pool-1[1..4] --duration 60 --out /artifacts/flame-2790011223.tar.gz

deploy-bot: deploy log: tokenizer-cache-refactor promoted at 2790010005, canary success -> full rollout to dedicated pools at 2790010100.

evan (sre): flamegraphs show a global mutex in tokenizer.lookup() dominating CPU during high-rate batch ingestion. large batches block subsequent small-latency requests behind the tokenizer hold.

marisol (oncall): mitigation options: 1) revert tokenizer refactor 2) enable per-worker local tokenizer instances (config toggle) 3) route large batch/embeddings traffic to separate dedicated-batch pool in another region 4) apply temporary customer throttles for noisy tenants. Let's quickly apply 2+3+4 to reduce impact while we assess revert.

tara (eng-runtime): I can flip the toggle to spawn local tokenizer instances per worker. Doing canary flip on dedicated-batch-pool-1-1 now.

ops-bot: runtime-cfg: set tokenizer.shared_cache.enabled=false --scope dedicated-batch-pool-1-1

marisol (oncall): canary result?

evan (sre): canary p95 for that node dropped from 2.4s -> 260ms within 45s. Good signal. Start progressive flip across batch pools.

marisol (oncall): infra, please apply routing override: move bulk embeddings traffic (prefix /v1/embeddings.bulk) to dedicated-batch-spare in eu-west-1 and apac spare pool. 60% shift.

ops-bot: routing: /infra/routing override --match-path "/v1/embeddings.bulk" --from-pools dedicated-batch-pool-* --to-pool dedicated-batch-spare --percent 60 --note "temp-mitigation-tokenizer-lock"

tara (eng-runtime): progressive flip completed across affected pools. overall cluster p95 improved to ~320ms and throughput regained ~75% baseline. still not fully normal but much better.

marisol (oncall): customer-impact assessment: heavy batch customers in EU/APAC could have experienced delayed embeddings or queued retries for ~18-30m. No request errors noted, but retries may have increased client-side latency. We should inform affected accounts.

cs-bot: drafting customer advisory (internal): "We observed increased latency for bulk embeddings in EU/APAC due to an internal tokenizer caching change. We applied mitigations (per-worker tokenizer toggle + routing bulk traffic) and performance is improving. No data loss. We'll follow up with a postmortem. If you saw increased latency or retrying requests, please contact support@redwood.ai and reference incident INC-2790-2026."

tara (eng-runtime): as a precaution, enabling fallback to quantized model variant for bulk embeddings to lower CPU/tokenization pressure on workers (deploying feature-flag to batch pool). This lowers accuracy slightly but reduces tokenization work by avoiding heavy preproc for some models.

ops-bot: feature-flag: set model.fallback.quantized=true --target dedicated-batch-spare --percent 100

evan (sre): after fallback enabled on spare, p95 for bulk path dropped further to ~200ms and throughput back to ~95% of baseline. Good.

marisol (oncall): customer communication plan: 1) publish status page short note now (investigating -> mitigations in progress) 2) send CS advisory to impacted customer list with recommended steps (retry/backoff suggestions, escalation link) 3) targeted AM outreach for top 10 affected accounts. Draft below:

status draft (short): "We are investigating increased embedding latency for EU and APAC customers. Engineers have applied per-worker tokenizer instances and rerouted bulk traffic; performance is improving. No data loss. Expected full restoration within 60 minutes. — Redwood Inference"

marisol: publish?

statusbot: STATUS PAGE: created incident INC-2790-2026. State: investigating -> mitigations in progress. Public note scheduled.

cs-bot: CS advisory queued: "We detected temporary increases in latency for bulk embeddings; mitigations applied. If you are experiencing issues, please increase client retry backoff and contact support. We'll publish a postmortem with root cause and actions." Will send to impacted list after publish.

tara (eng-runtime): root cause confirmed in stack traces: tokenizer cache refactor introduced a global lookup mutex to synchronize cache fills. Under high batch ingestion, lock contention serialized tokenization work, creating head-of-line blocking. Regression introduced by dedupe attempt.

tara: immediate action items: 1) keep per-worker tokenizer toggle on for batch pools (owner: tara) 2) open revert PR for tokenizer-refactor + safer per-worker caching design w/ sharded cache and lock-free reads (owner: tara) 3) add e2e perf test for high-batch ingestion + mixed latency traffic (owner: perf infra) 4) add alert for tokenizer lookup mutex hold time > 50ms (owner: evan). I'll own 1 & 2.

evan (sre): assigning postmortem owner: @harrison. I'll hand over monitoring notes and artifacts. Postmortem target: publish within 72 hours.

marisol (oncall): mitigation timeline: toggle + routing applied at +8m after alert; quantized fallback at +14m; full recovery to ~95% baseline at +22m. We'll include timeline in incident folder.

deploy-bot: ARTIFACTS: flame-2790011223.tar.gz, routing-override-2790011223.log, feature-flag-changes.log, deploys.log uploaded to /incidents/INC-2790-2026/artifacts

harrison: taking postmortem. will coordinate with tara & evan for RCA and remediation plan. thanks for the quick mitigation. Target publish within 72h.

marisol (oncall): internal comms template for AMs/CS: "We experienced a transient increase in embedding latency for EU and APAC due to a tokenizer caching change. Engineering applied mitigations and performance is returning to normal. No data loss. For customers wanting immediate relief, we recommend switching heavy bulk embedding jobs to dedicated-batch-spare or enabling quantized fallback. Incident ID INC-2790-2026. Contact support@redwood.ai to escalate." Use this for account outreach.

marisol: handoff to next oncall @harrison for post-incident monitoring and postmortem follow-up. Watch period: 60m. Good work team. :thumbsup:

statusbot: UPDATE: incident INC-2790-2026 -> mitigations applied; monitoring. Public note updated: "Mitigated: per-worker tokenizer toggle + routing and model fallback applied; metrics stabilizing. Postmortem forthcoming." ETA to close: 24h pending postmortem.

ops-bot: paging silence scheduled to lift in 1h. Incident timeline and artifacts saved. Thread archived after closure.
